name: auditforge-iso42001
description: AuditForge ISO 42001 - Workbench for ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Auditors (BUSL-1.1)

scripts.audit-runner:dev: cd services/audit-evidence-runner && uv run uvicorn services.audit_evidence_runner.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8088
scripts.audit-runner:lint: cd services/audit-evidence-runner && uv run ruff check .
scripts.infra:validate:dev: cd infra/terraform/environments/dev && terraform init -backend=false && terraform validate
scripts.infra:validate:staging: cd infra/terraform/environments/staging && terraform init -backend=false && terraform validate
scripts.infra:validate:prod: cd infra/terraform/environments/prod && terraform init -backend=false && terraform validate
scripts.infra:validate: pnpm infra:validate:dev && pnpm infra:validate:staging && pnpm infra:validate:prod
scripts.infra:plan:dev: cd infra/terraform/environments/dev && terraform init && terraform plan
scripts.infra:plan:staging: cd infra/terraform/environments/staging && terraform init && terraform plan
scripts.infra:plan:prod: cd infra/terraform/environments/prod && terraform init && terraform plan
scripts.infra:apply:dev: cd infra/terraform/environments/dev && terraform init && terraform apply
scripts.infra:apply:staging: cd infra/terraform/environments/staging && terraform init && terraform apply
scripts.infra:apply:prod: cd infra/terraform/environments/prod && terraform init && terraform apply
